subject: Urban Planning
title: Autonomous Vehicles and Urban Form
description: A short lesson to help you apply Autonomous Vehicles and Urban Form.

hook.text: Self-driving cars could eliminate parking lots, reduce crashes, and reshape every city. Or make sprawl worse.

buildup.text: If cars drive themselves, parking can move to the edge of town. Downtown lots become parks or housing.

discovery.text: But cheap autonomous rides could replace transit. Why take a bus if a robot taxi costs the same?

twist.text: If commutes are effortless, people might live even farther out. AVs could supercharge suburban sprawl.

climax.text: Planners face a fork: regulate AVs to support cities, or let the market scatter them across exurbs.

punchline.text: Self-driving cars will reshape cities. The question is who decides how.

quiz.question: How might autonomous vehicles worsen urban sprawl?
options: By increasing traffic congestion in downtown areas
By making long commutes effortless, encouraging people to live farther out
By raising the cost of urban parking significantly
